title: Mossborn
description: A lightweight PVP military-styled pack centering on post-apocalyptic warfare and combat
body:
Mossborn is a lightweight PVP focused modpack placed in a moss-ridden world (created by [Milkshake___](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/milkshake___/))

With mods such as TaCZ, and addons; Create, along with Big Cannons and The Factory Must Grow; and plenty options for shaders, this is a fun way to compete with friends, or work with them to survive in this post-apocalyptic city

There's plenty of lore (again, courtesy of Milkshake) and with it, space to explore.

I hope you enjoy!


SIDE NOTE: the discord server is super small, I don't even know if I will continue this to update this. Join if you feel like it, I guess

Recommended Config:
- memory: 4G. it's not massive, but I find it runs smoother with higher RAM
- GUI scale: not typical for modpack configs, but since it uses Fancymenu and I didnt put in the effort to change stuff automatically, I recommend setting it to 3. This will probably be patched in a future update.

-----------

This modpack is only a compilation, I am not affiliated with creators of mods, shaders, or the main world. And as such, all creations are the propriety of the makers.
